description: React component for a Trello-like board container with drag-and-drop lanes and cards, integrating Redux actions and state.

classes.name: BoardContainer
classes.description: React component managing a Trello-like board with lanes and cards, supporting drag-and-drop, event bus, and lane/card management.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Loads the board data and wires event bus if handle provided.

methods.name: UNSAFE_componentWillReceiveProps
methods.description: Handles updates to props, reloads board data if necessary.

methods.name: onDragStart
methods.description: Handles drag start event for lanes.

methods.name: onLaneDrop
methods.description: Handles drop event for lanes, moves lanes if indices differ.

methods.name: getCardDetails
methods.description: Retrieves card details given lane ID and card index.

methods.name: wireEventBus
methods.description: Sets up event bus with actions for card and lane operations.

methods.name: hideEditableLane
methods.description: Hides the UI for adding a new lane.

methods.name: showEditableLane
methods.description: Shows the UI for adding a new lane.

methods.name: addNewLane
methods.description: Adds a new lane and updates UI.

methods.name: groupName
methods.description: Generates a group name string based on component ID.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the board with lanes, cards, and optional lane addition UI.
